notes: Replies in the app chat now show bold, lists and links properly (no more ** signs). After you say YES, you get a normal answer, never code-like text. One confirmation only: the request itself, and "Reply YES" without a number when only one thing is waiting (a new request for the same site replaces the old one; requests expire after 30 minutes). A 👍 is a real reaction on your message, never its own message. Site changes come with a picture instead of pasted code, and pictures are taken after the page finishes loading. Published sites show a proper "Page not found" page for wrong addresses (or your site's own 404.html).
